name: Team API rejects bad input with 4xx, not 5xx
description: Strict Pydantic schemas and unknown ids must surface as clean client errors, never 500s: malformed body -> 422, unknown campaign -> 404, unknown member -> 401.

planSteps.description: GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/members and capture a lead member id for the X-Member-Id header used below.
POST {base_url}/api/v1/team/strategy/sessions with the lead X-Member-Id header and a malformed JSON body that omits the required 'inputs' field, e.g. {"idea":"missing the inputs array"}.
Verify the response status is in the 4xx range (expected 422) with a JSON error detail, and is not a 5xx.
GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/campaigns/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/board with the lead X-Member-Id header (a syntactically valid but non-existent campaign id).
Verify the response is a 404 with a JSON error body, not a 500.

POST {base_url}/api/v1/campaign/generate with a JSON body that is valid except for one unexpected extra field, e.g. {"product_name":"X","product_description":"Y","target_audience":"Z","marketing_goal":"awareness","user_prompt":"draft it","unexpected_field":true}.
Verify the response is 422 (the request schema forbids extra fields) with a JSON error body, not a 5xx.
GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/campaigns with header X-Member-Id set to a member id that does not exist (simulating a different tenant or made-up member).
Verify the API refuses it with a 401 and does not leak any campaign data.
